svg.text: Groups are points per line; "real" is the 1000 real-world lines, median 82 points. Between rounds a cell moved by a median of 5% to 7%, so bars closer than that are a tie.
Not drawn, to keep the scale readable: polyline-encoded (0.10x to 0.36x), @lp-labs/polyline-codec (0.04x to 0.13x), decode-google-map-polyline (0.01x to 0.08x).
Also not drawn: polytini's web and wasm entries. All of them are in docs/results.md.
